title: ...prepare for an international flight
desc: Ensure smooth border clearance, document readiness, and stress-free transit.
todos: Verify passport validity extends at least 6 months past planned return date.
Check destination visa and digital entry form requirements (e.g., ETIAS/ESTA).
Notify credit card companies and bank of international travel dates.
Download offline maps and translation language packs to your smartphone.
Pack physical printed copies of key travel documents and emergency contacts.
